title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets

sources.title: Computational and Experimental Analysis of SPICE Data Sets

key_findings: Microgravity conditions produced longer, more diffuse flames with lower temperatures and increased soot concentrations compared to normal gravity.
Integration of experimental temperature fields into simulations reduced discrepancies between measured and predicted soot distributions.
Sensitivity analyses of soot evolution parameters showed significant effects of radiation, scattering, boundary conditions, and heat transfer to the burner structure.
fields.earth_applications: The results support safer fire detection, suppression, and cleaner combustion technologies critical for long-duration missions on Earth.
